description: The open web searches and five substantive body reads did not establish any October 2020 gathering in Azerbaijan with both an evidenced crowd of at least 50 and a concrete demand directed at Azerbaijan’s own state or policy. This is a research result, not evidence that no such event occurred.
required_followup: Independent local, regional and international reporting or systematic newspaper/archive searches.

description: Twelve of 40 submitted queries were not captured with their actual result headers: Q001–Q004 and Q021–Q028. Their query strings are retained; logs have empty returned_results/returned_urls with output_status=lost. Those arrays mean unknown output, not zero results.
required_followup: Rerun only if needed in a future authorized session, capturing the actual outputs promptly.

description: Managed public web search is not LexisNexis All News or a systematic newspaper search; query date windows are not guaranteed to be honored. Search returns repeatedly surfaced October 2019 Baku demonstrations and July 2020 rallies. Regional/local outlet coverage and result-ranking limitations remain.
required_followup: Systematic contemporaneous newspaper/archive searches and source-level date review.

description: The exact Oxu.az article body could not be opened: managed open returned Internal Error and URL inaccessible. This is recorded as a technical failure, not a denial; it remains search_only and was not retried.
required_followup: If future work needs its details, use a fresh access check and only ordinary public retrieval.

description: The 6 October Azneft Square support action report gives no attendance estimate. It is excluded because no own-state demand is reported; the threshold remains unknown.
required_followup: Reassess only if a source establishes a distinct concrete demand to Azerbaijan’s government/policy and simultaneous attendance.

description: Searches found support rallies and protests outside Azerbaijan, including Iran and German diaspora events. These are not observations for Azerbaijan’s unit. Some other foreign/embassy-related results remained search-only and were not coded as candidates.
required_followup: None for Azerbaijan ownership; refer to country-specific research only under its separate assignment.

description: A 31 October Reddit post claimed Russian residents staged a mass rally but was tagged HUMOR and used a meme; the opened post supplied no evidence of a real gathering. It is retained as a false lead, not an event.
required_followup: None unless contemporaneous independent evidence of an actual gathering appears.

description: No October-starting eligible protest episode was established, so no continuation was coded. Searches into 1–7 November returned mainly unrelated 2019 material and did not establish an October event continuing into November.
required_followup: Recheck neighboring-month local reporting if a qualifying October start is later discovered.

description: The official baseline, schema, ccode mapping and country code remain unverified; ccode was therefore not assigned.
